# Tier `ampere-6`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `q8_0` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `offload-e4b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e4b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

The installer seeds this tier's media bindings (`config_seed`):

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `compose_script` | `render/compose-hyperframes.mjs` |
| `imagegen_cfg` | `1` |
| `imagegen_engine` | `sdcpp` |
| `imagegen_family` | `sdxl-turbo` |
| `imagegen_steps` | `4` |
| `imagegen_timeout_sec` | `900` |
| `sdcpp_bin` | `__OFFLOAD_HOME__/sdcpp/sd-cli__EXE__` |
| `sdcpp_model` | `__OFFLOAD_HOME__/models/sdxl-turbo/stable-diffusion-xl-1.0-turbo-Q4_0.gguf` |
| `sdcpp_model_kind` | `checkpoint` |
| `upscale_model` | `4x-UltraSharp.pth` |
| `vae_mode` | `tiling` |

`__OFFLOAD_HOME__` is replaced with the install root at render time.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Configs #10/#11 (3050 6GB). **MEASURED 2026-07-26** on an RTX 3050 6GB + i9-9900 + 32GB DDR4-2667 (spec: docs/specs/2026-07-26-ampere-6-tier-design.md). (1) RESIDENT TIER E2B -> E4B: E4B at 16K/q8_0 occupies only 3100 MiB of 6144, so the stronger workhorse fits with room to spare - a pure GPU-side win. (2) CTX 16K -> 32K: the projected 'may downshift to 8K' worry was unfounded; E4B reaches 64K/f16 in 4046 MiB and E2B 64K/f16 in 2078 MiB. 32K is chosen to leave GPU headroom for whatever else shares the card. (3) 'q8_0 KV is MANDATORY' was FALSE: Gemma-4 E-series uses a 512-token sliding window with only periodic global layers, so KV barely grows - f16 at 16K costs just 130 MiB more than q8_0. q8_0 is kept as the conservative default; f16 is available if a deployment wants it. (4) **26B STAYS DROPPED - THIS IS AN ARCHITECTURAL DECISION, NOT A CAPACITY LIMIT. DO NOT 'FIX' IT.** The 26B-A4B was measured to RUN here (--n-cpu-moe 24 serves at 32K, 210 pp / 13.5 tg), so a future reader WILL be tempted to enable it. Don't: any MoE tier puts experts in CPU+RAM, and boxes in this class are SERVERS whose CPU and RAM are reserved for their services - inference is confined to the GPU. Enabling it also pushes VRAM to ~5.3GB of 6144, starving a desktop session sharing the card. [AMENDED 2026-10-09: the 26B stays dropped (Gemma 4 26B-A4B FAILED spill stability in the 2026-10-07/08 lean bake), but "no expert may sit in RAM" is no longer this tier's rule: the operator's 2026-10-07 spill ruling admits a RAM spill that truly adds capability, is no RAM hog and leaves the system stable, and one seat passed all three - see AGENT SEAT SPILL at the end of these notes.] If a genuinely dedicated inference box ever lands in this profile, give it its OWN profile id rather than flipping this one. Throughput: E2B 2631 pp / 90.9 tg; E4B 1529 pp / 48.1 tg. The 70W power cap (not raisable) is the real limiter - the card sustains ~1639 MHz of a 2100 MHz max at 58W mean. NOTE for ZFS hosts: ARC grew to 19.9GB of 31GB here and is NOT counted in MemAvailable, so cap zfs_arc_max to keep the memory picture honest for the services. TIER-DOCTRINE PASS 2026-08-16: reviewed; seats are the best that fit — no change. **AGENT SEAT BOUND 2026-08-17 (qwen3.5-4b-agent) — the first measured sub-27B agent-seat decision the house has ever had.** 15 candidates across families were served on the reference RTX 3050 and scored on TWO task shapes with FABRICATION as the disqualifying axis: shape B (read 3 docs -> structured extraction, 18-fact gold set) and shape C (5-file fixture with distractors -> search+select, cross-file arithmetic with a unit conversion, conditional reasoning, and a fabrication trap). Qwen3.5-4B is the ONLY candidate strong on BOTH - 67% extraction (vs the e4b incumbent's 50%) and 4/5 search+reason - at 3681 MiB with ctx 32768 q8_0, which fits beside the resident support tier. Every other candidate fails one of the tier's FOUR mapped failure modes: (1) loop and never answer (qwen3.5-2b wins extraction at 78% then scores 1/5 on shape C, deriving right answers in prose and looping until the budget dies), (2) answer from partial reads (qwen3-30b-a3b scores the highest extraction of anything tested at 83% and then 1/5 - valid JSON with confidently WRONG content, which is worse for a delegation lane than returning nothing), (3) refuse tools entirely (ling-mini-2.0), (4) never emit valid JSON (lfm2.5). ZERO fabrications from any model across ~40 runs and both shapes - these models omit rather than invent, which is the property the delegation design depends on. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP matched the winner on both shapes and is REJECTED ON THIS TIER'S ROLE BOUNDARY, not on quality: it needs RSS 21.7 GB on a box whose baseline available RAM is 24.3 GB and which runs 24/7 services - recorded as the ceiling this tier could reach if a node were ever repurposed as a dedicated inference box. [UPDATED 2026-10-09: the 21.7 GB RSS belongs to that MTP build; the lean UD-IQ3_XXS build of the same family holds ~11.6 GB and is the tier's agent seat on a 32 GB-class box - see AGENT SEAT SPILL below.] **TWO CONFIGURATION FACTS THAT ARE LOAD-BEARING, BOTH MEASURED - DO NOT 'TIDY' THEM AWAY.** (a) The seat's llama-swap entry writes its flags EXPLICITLY instead of using the ${common} macro, because ${common} pins `--reasoning off` and this is a THINKING model: measured at the deployed ctx, with a FRESH server per run (n=3 per arm, zero spread) the same seat scores 67%/67%/67% under llama.cpp's default reasoning and collapses to 28%/28%/28% with `--reasoning off`, while the search+reason shape is 4/5 on both arms — so reasoning-off costs half the extraction recall and buys nothing. The cascade's reasoning-off invariant must never be extended to this entry. (b) The AGENT PROFILE is the single biggest lever on this tier - same model, same contract, `--profile general` (the DEFAULT, 11 tools) scores 0% with zero output bytes while `--profile research` scores 72%. The delegation lane already defaulted to `research`, and this tier now SEEDS `agent_profile: research` so the other agent front doors (the `agent_run` MCP tool and the `local-agent` CLI) inherit it instead of falling to bare `general` by omission — that open question is CLOSED, on the measurement above. An explicit per-call/`--profile` value still wins, and `--two-tier` is exempt because it sets its own architect/editor toolsets. Full evidence: Benchmarks and Optimizations/2026-08-17-ampere6-seat-bakeoff/ (the tier matrix records the seat DECISION; benchmark data lives in the benchmarks folder, not in the workbook). **AGENT SEAT SPILL 2026-10-09 (qwen3.6-35b-a3b-agent, ADR 0080) - on a box with the RAM, the agent seat is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, not the 4B.** unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF, Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-IQ3_XXS.gguf (12.30 GiB; 35B total, ~3B active; Apache-2.0), the routed experts in host RAM through a literal `--n-cpu-moe 40` (the tier's `n_cpu_moe_max` 40 is the measured spill the write gate checks it against), attention, the dense layers and the KV cache on the card. MEASURED in the 2026-10-07/08 lean bake on the reference 6 GB node (llama.cpp b10964) against the three gates of the operator's spill ruling ("acceptable spill as long as it truly adds capability and does not become a RAM hog or make the system unstable"). (1) ADDS CAPABILITY, blind pack G4, judge claude-opus-5, 24 judgements: overall 8.11 vs the incumbent Qwen3.5-4B's 7.26 (gap 0.85 against a 0.5 bar), 17/24 head to head; accuracy 8.34 vs 8.01, specificity 8.32 vs 7.58, coverage 8.12 vs 6.93; degradations 4 vs 23; minor fabrications 9 vs 6, serious 3 vs 3. Speed on the hard-8 set 1,399 s vs 4,818 s (decode 16.5 vs 7.9 tok/s heat-soaked); grounded digest-8 8/8 in 654 s vs the incumbent's 8/8 in 1,066 s. The other arms lost: gpt-oss-20b was void (swap-in abort) and Gemma 4 26B-A4B failed spill stability. (2) NOT A RAM HOG: ~11.6 GB host RSS while loaded (weights + 1 GiB), released on unload; `--cache-ram 0` is deliberate because the host prompt cache grew ~1 GiB per digest run; MemAvailable minimum 5,446 MiB on a 32 GB box beside a game server. ~2.1 GB on the card at the 32768 window with q8_0 KV. (3) STABLE: no abort and zero swap-in across the runs with the flags in the template (`--batch-size 2048 --ubatch-size 512 --parallel 1 --load-mode none`; a THINKING model, so no --reasoning flag). HOW IT IS GATED: `include_qwen36_35b` lets the tier carry the entry, the entry renders only when ram_tier is low, mid or high (>= 28 GB, which is what a 32 GB box reports; `min` boxes render as before), and `config_seed_ram_low_up` binds agent_model to it on exactly those boxes - the base `config_seed.agent_model` stays qwen3.5-4b-agent, which is what a `min` box keeps. qwen3.5-4b-agent stays rendered beside it as an opt-in un-aliased rollback (it hands the agent-seat alias to the new seat), so pointing agent_model back at it is a config edit, not a re-render. REQUIRES llama.cpp >= b10964 (`--load-mode` replaced --no-mmap) and the Windows install pins a build at or above that. The single-slot rule is unchanged: the seat serves `--parallel 1`, so fleet_max_concurrent_jobs stays 1. **MEMORY STACK 2026-10-09 (include_embeddinggemma2):** this tier also renders the embeddinggemma2 entry (EmbeddingGemma-2 Q8_0 + its multimodal projector) in the stack residency set beside embeddinggemma and the reranker, by operator order via the memory-stack session (EmbeddingGemma-2 replaces EmbeddingGemma-300m for the whole stack; the harness ships the entry, the memory stack owns the cutover). Measured on the reference 6 GB node: 1,196 MiB loaded, 1,466 MiB peak after image embeds, 1,536 MiB after a short video, 482 MiB text-only at ubatch 2048. Needs llama.cpp >= b11452 (b11490 proven). The 300M entry stays for the harness's own embed lane and its aliases. This tier is the memory authority's card: it carries the entry WITH the projector (embeddinggemma2_projector true), so it embeds text, images and short video; ampere-8 and blackwell-3x16 render the text-only entry.
